citation: Sengan S, Shieh C-S (2026). Non-IID and aware federated intrusion detection with PBFT with secured model aggregation for multi institutional healthcare internet of things networks. Scientific Reports.
url_read: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-026-56167-4.pdf (read via WebFetch; direct download blocked by proxy)

A1.evidence: No train/validation/test split stated; only 'The federation is simulated by partitioning the IoT-Flock and CICIoT2023 across K = 12 virtual institutional nodes' (Experimental setup).

A2.evidence: Table 3: 'BiLSTM Sequence length T 10'; construction of sequences and split not described.

A3.evidence: Normalization Eq. (25) uses institution-specific statistics mu^pi_{k,j}, sigma^pi_{k,j}; not stated whether computed on training data only.

A4.evidence: Table 4: 'Local training steps per round tau 10', 'Maximum federation rounds Tmax 200'.

A5.evidence: No statement that FedAvg/FedProx/SCAFFOLD/FedNova use the Table 4 settings; only 'All federated methods share the same base local computation cost of O(tau N_k p)' (complexity analysis).

A6.evidence: Table 13 'Comparison of SOTA' lists published results (e.g., Begum et al. Edge-IIoTset/TON-IoT, Peng et al. N-BaIoT) from other papers; Table 6 baselines appear run by authors.

A8.evidence: 'Dirichlet-based class proportion sampling ... at 3 concentration levels alpha in {0.1, 0.5, 1.0}' plus quantity and feature skew.

A9.evidence: Table 7: '± values represent standard deviation across alpha in {0.1, 0.5, 1.0} heterogeneity severity levels'; fixed seed 42; no repeated runs.

A10.evidence: Datasets evaluated separately; Limitations mentions 'generalization gap of 8.47% between the IoT-Flock and CICIoT2023 transfer directions' but no cross-dataset experiment is reported.

notes: Mixed baselines: six baselines (centralized BC+DL, FedAvg, FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedNova, no-PBFT variant) apparently run by authors in Tables 6-7 without stated parity; Table 13 compares with numbers from other papers (A6=copied because some copied). A5 coded for the re-run baselines. ± values are across heterogeneity levels, not runs. Text read through WebFetch extraction, not a local PDF.
